// See the comment above authgateOverlay: soft gate, preview build only, // not real security. if (import.meta.env.VITE_PREVIEW) { const LS_USER = 'gb_authgate_user'; const LS_HASH = 'gb_authgate_hash'; async function sha256Hex(text) { const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(text); const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', bytes); return [...new Uint8Array(digest)].map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); } const overlay = document.getElementById('authgateOverlay'); const form = document.getElementById('authgateForm'); const title = document.getElementById('authgateTitle'); const hint = document.getElementById('authgateHint'); const userInput = document.getElementById('authgateUser'); const passInput = document.getElementById('authgatePass'); const submitBtn = document.getElementById('authgateSubmit'); const errorEl = document.getElementById('authgateError'); const savedUser = localStorage.getItem(LS_USER); const savedHash = localStorage.getItem(LS_HASH); const mode = (savedUser && savedHash) ? 'login' : 'setup'; if (mode === 'setup') { title.textContent = 'Set up access'; hint.textContent = 'This is a shared preview link — set a username and password to open it.'; submitBtn.textContent = 'Set username & password'; passInput.autocomplete = 'new-password'; } else { title.textContent = 'Log in'; hint.textContent = 'Enter the username and password for this preview link.'; submitBtn.textContent = 'Log in'; passInput.autocomplete = 'current-password'; } // Not dismissible: the overlay has no close button, and — deliberately — // nothing here listens for a backdrop click or an Escape keypress. The // only way past it is the form below. document.body.classList.add('authgate-locked'); overlay.hidden = false; userInput.focus(); form.addEventListener('submit', async e => { e.preventDefault(); errorEl.textContent = ''; const user = userInput.value.trim(); const pass = passInput.value; if (!user || !pass.trim()) { errorEl.textContent = 'Enter a username and password.'; return; } const hash = await sha256Hex(pass); if (mode === 'setup') { localStorage.setItem(LS_USER, user); localStorage.setItem(LS_HASH, hash); unlock(); } else if (user === savedUser && hash === savedHash) { unlock(); } else { errorEl.textContent = 'Wrong username or password.'; passInput.value = ''; passInput.focus(); } }); function unlock() { overlay.hidden = true; document.body.classList.remove('authgate-locked'); } }
